tokens.name: ground
tokens.usage: Page background behind every panel.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Cards, panels, table bodies.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Hovered rows, popovers, the selected tab, scoreboard header.

tokens.name: hairline
tokens.usage: Decorative dividers and table row rules only; never the sole border of a control.

tokens.name: text
tokens.usage: Body copy and table values on ground, surface and surface-raised (12.9:1 or better in both themes).

tokens.name: text-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text, axis labels, sample sizes, timestamps on ground, surface and surface-raised (5.6:1 or better).

tokens.name: gilt
tokens.usage: Page titles, headline numbers and the active nav item on any surface (6.5:1 or better).

tokens.name: brass
tokens.usage: Primary accent: rules, control borders, focus ring, primary button fill. 4.3:1 or better on every surface, so it is safe for borders and large text, not body copy.

tokens.name: on-brass
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a brass fill (7.7:1 dusk, 4.7:1 parchment).

tokens.name: team-amber
tokens.usage: The Amber Hand team: scoreboard stripe, chart series, team label. Always paired with the team name.

tokens.name: team-sapphire
tokens.usage: The Sapphire Flame team: scoreboard stripe, chart series, team label. Always paired with the team name.

tokens.name: win
tokens.usage: Win result text and win-rate bars above 50%. Always with the word Win or a W; never colour alone.

tokens.name: loss
tokens.usage: Loss result text and win-rate bars below 50%. Always with the word Loss or an L; never colour alone.

styles.name: display-xl
styles.usage: Home page title and the player's name on a profile. One per page.

styles.name: display-l
styles.usage: Section titles on meta pages and the match result banner.

styles.name: h1
styles.usage: Page-level heading under a display title.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Win rate across the last 30 days, ranked matches only.
styles.usage: All running prose: explanations, empty states, model cards.

styles.name: body-small
styles.sample: Based on 1,284 matches at Phantom and above.
styles.usage: Captions under charts, helper text, tooltips.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Uppercase stat labels, table headers, tabs.

styles.name: stat-xl
styles.usage: Headline numbers in stat blocks (win rate, KDA).

styles.name: stat
styles.usage: Secondary numbers in stat blocks and scoreboard totals.

styles.name: table
styles.usage: Every number in a table so columns align.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon to label gap.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap inside a stat block; table cell vertical padding.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Table cell horizontal padding; chip padding.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card padding on phones; page gutter on phones.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Card padding on desktop; gap between cards; stepped-corner depth on large cards.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Gap between page sections.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Space above a display title.

tokens.name: radius-none
tokens.usage: Cards, panels and tables: deco is square-cornered; corners are stepped, not rounded.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, chips.

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: Rank badge discs and hero portraits only.

corner.note: Depth of the stepped deco corner cut with clip-path.

tokens.name: corner-step-sm
tokens.usage: Stat blocks, chips, small cards.

tokens.name: corner-step-lg
tokens.usage: Page panels and the match result banner.
